describe: The image shows a weathered bronze or copper surface with a green-grey verdigris patina and brown patches. Blurred sculpted relief shapes resemble a face or head: rounded forms and a spiral-like swirl on the right side, with lighter pale highlights and a brownish-pink smudge on the left. Lighting is soft and low-contrast with dim shadows. Metal material with a fine mottled texture and no clear regular pattern.
